## Coming from BacaKomik?
On Android, Yoru is a new app next to BacaKomik. Before you uninstall BacaKomik, bring your library over: sync it with Drive in BacaKomik and sign in to Drive sync in Yoru, or back it up in BacaKomik and restore the file in Yoru (More → Backup & sync). The 2.17.0 notes have the details.

## Changes

### New
- Linux: an RPM for Fedora, `Yoru-2.19.0-linux-x86_64.rpm`. Install it with `sudo dnf install ./Yoru-2.19.0-linux-x86_64.rpm`. An RPM install updates from inside the app: approve the system's administrator prompt, and the app restarts on the new version. Contributed by @fluoz.

### Fixed
- Covers and images no longer stay placeholders until you restart the app when many load at once, as on the first sync of a big library. A download that stalls stops after 30 seconds, and a cover that fails to load tries again a few times.
